**1 — Scene:** A mixed meal with a large leafy salad, green beans, a small skin-on fish portion topped with rice, and a reddish grain-based mound at the upper edge. The latter is partly cropped and harder to identify.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, roughly square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a circular approximation gives **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²** of usable area.

**3 — Items:** Mixed leafy greens, cooked green beans, skin-on fish, a little rice over the fish, reddish seasoned rice/grains, and a light visible oil/dressing sheen. The food on the separate plate at lower left is excluded.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Area shares below represent non-overlapping allocations of the plate footprint. Oil is counted separately rather than as another footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens | 38% | 217 cm² × 3 cm = 651 ml | 0.15 | 98 g | 20 | 20 kcal |
| Cooked green beans | 17% | 97 cm² × 1.6 cm = 155 ml | 0.60 | 93 g | 35 | 33 kcal |
| Skin-on fish | 10% | 57 cm² × 1.5 cm = 86 ml | 0.95 | 82 g | 180 | 148 kcal |
| Rice over fish | 7% | 40 cm² × 0.7 cm = 28 ml | 0.80 | 22 g | 130 | 29 kcal |
| Reddish seasoned rice/grains | 10% | 57 cm² × 2 cm = 114 ml | 0.80 | 91 g | 160 | 146 kcal |
| Oil/dressing sheen | Shared | Approximately 8 ml | 0.92 | 7 g | 884 | 62 kcal |

**8 — Sanity check:** The allocated footprints total **82%** of the plate, consistent with the substantial exposed rim and spaces. The small rice topping remains only about 22 g, while the leafy pile has considerable volume but little weight. Estimated total: **393 g and 438 kcal**, with the greatest uncertainty coming from the cropped reddish food and the amount of oil.
